title: Becoming Martian
description:
E3
Evolutionary biologist Dr. Scott Solomon foresees a series of changes to our species from the size of our hearts and heads to the pigments in our skin.

title: Space Phenomena
description:
S2026
NASA's next-generation space telescope TESS (Exoplanet Survey Satellite) searches for Earth-like planets belonging to other star systems.

title: Space Phenomena
description:
S2026
The latest discoveries are drawing a link between black holes and the existence of life.

title: Our Violent Sun
description:
S2026
Our Sun could erupt at any moment, spewing a vast wave of charged particles toward Earth that could leave millions of people without power for up to a year.

title: Amazing Gravity
description:
E1
Professor Jim Al-Khalili tries to find where gravity is weakest in Britain and where humans weigh the least.

title: Amazing Gravity
description:
E2
Using Einstein's elaborate theories, Jim Al-Khalili looks at whether the rate humans age is affected by gravity and the speed at which the Earth moves.

title: Becoming Martian
description:
E1
The journey to the neighboring planet traces a path connecting Nikola Tesla, Nazi weapons of war, a Cold War space race, and a string of blockbuster discoveries made by some of NASA's most talented robots.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description:
E1
A look at the men and women who've run and, in some cases, won the Oval Office.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description:
E2
A look at some of history's criminals, con artists, frauds and fakes, from Adam Worth, the 19th-century inspiration for Professor Moriarty, to a jewel thief named Diamond Doris and a count who sold the Eiffel Tower to gullible buyers twice.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description:
E3
A look at espionage; meeting spies from Delilah to Roald Dahl and along the way revealing the real model for James Bond.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description:
E4
A look at wars that lasted for centuries and others that were over in minutes, as well as the difficulty of ending a war; the possibility of starting a war over almost anything, from an unprovoked invasion to a lost ear, a pastry or a stolen bucket.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description:
E5
Throughout history, men and women have dedicated themselves to raking in wealth in the form of old money, new money and blood money; a look at how they got it, spent it and how it affected their happiness, from Robber Barons to Mansa Musa of Mali.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description:
E6
Exploring why, from Liz Taylor to Attila the Hun, pain doesn't stop people from looking for love; how love is a driver of history, costing royalty their heads, generals their victories, and many people their sanity.
